rationale: A0026 flagged T110 as asserting T109 as the current product-run simulation evidence source while T112 has since replaced T109 as the current registry-bound source. A0035 implements the minimal contract and dependency edits required to repair that open impact: the Outcome/Deliverables language now sources RunState from T112 simulation evidence, T109 is explicitly retained as a historical read-only predecessor only, T112 is added to the contract Dependencies and References, and todo/config.yaml's T110.depends_on is extended from [T040, T041, T052, T061, T100, T104, T109] to [T040, T041, T052, T061, T100, T104, T109, T112]. The T109 A/B/C delayed-fill fixture reference in Acceptance is preserved as a historical test artifact. No Must-not, safety, execution, signer, or live-authority clause was weakened. No field of T110 outside depends_on was touched in todo/config.yaml; no other task record was touched; workflow_state, active_task, active_phase, intent_revision, spec_revision, and agent_runtime remain unchanged. The drift check at finish-amendment will see contract and config agree that T110 depends on T112.
